overview_description.description:
Cantalop.com is the 1st Regional Job Search Engine dedicated to Egypt & MENA Region. 
We aim to support economies and people in this region for a better life and brighter future through tackling unemployment, improving household incomes and creating healthier and more transparent Job Market place.
With 222 million internet user in MENA, Cantalop aims to become the biggest online job market place in MENA Region
